per_arm_note: The four full runs share instance 57030878 with the pilots and probes, so the billed total cannot be split per arm exactly. At that instance's GPU rate (0.533 USD/h) the four training phases (93.5, 93.3, 93.3 and 92.2 min) are about 3.3 USD and the four checkpoint-reload checks about 0.5 USD; model loading and evaluation were not timed separately.
